candidates.body: Q1 FY27 results were published on July 9, 2026. Revenue grew 13.93% year on year to Rs 72,275 crore and net profit grew 4.62% to Rs 13,349 crore. The quarter ended June 30, 2026.
candidates.title: TCS reported Q1 FY27 revenue of Rs 72,275 crore (up 13.93% YoY) and net profit of Rs 13,349 crore (up 4.62% YoY)

candidates.body: The board declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per equity share for FY27, payable to shareholders on the record date of July 15, 2026.
candidates.title: TCS declared an interim dividend of Rs 12 per share for FY27

candidates.body: TCS reported that its AI initiatives include strategic partnerships with Anthropic and Mistral AI plus an expanded Google Cloud collaboration, with annualized AI-related revenue of $2.6 billion.
candidates.title: TCS expanded strategic AI partnerships with Anthropic and Mistral AI and deepened the Google Cloud collaboration

candidates.body: On the Q1 FY27 earnings call, management described the demand environment as strong and cited a $9.5 billion order book for the quarter. This is a management statement, not an independent fact.
candidates.title: TCS management: the demand environment remains strong with a healthy order pipeline

candidates.body: A recorded press report suggested order intake declined on a sequential basis for the second consecutive quarter, in apparent tension with management commentary about a strong demand environment. This is a reported claim, not an established fact.
candidates.title: Reported: TCS order intake declined sequentially for a second consecutive quarter

candidates.body: TCS noted that wage inflation, attrition pressure, and INR/USD volatility remain the main near-term risks to operating margins. This is a disclosed risk statement.
candidates.title: TCS flagged wage inflation, attrition, and currency volatility as near-term margin risks

candidates.body: Sector-level reporting indicates clients continue to defer discretionary spending, keeping order momentum cautious across the Indian IT services sector. INR/USD volatility adds uncertainty. This is indirect, outside-in intelligence.
candidates.title: Indian IT services order momentum stays cautious as clients defer discretionary spending
